verses.1: To David, the words of Jehovah: “May the Lord be with me, my God who stands before me until the end. May his enemies bleed from their wounds.”
verses.2: The Lord will send His arrows from Zion, to strike you near your enemies.
verses.3: Your people will offer sacrifices on the day of your battle, in the holy days, from far away, from every direction. They will bring you rain and blessings.
verses.4: May the LORD be praised, and may you, priest, never weep forever over my words, O righteous king.
verses.5: Adonai, on your right hand, is exalted on the day of kings.
verses.6: The nations are full of many tribes; they cover a vast land.
verses.7: From the spring along the path, it will flow down to the ground.
